breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions, specifying both Dirichlet (u=0 on the boundary) and periodic conditions. The ground truth prompt correctly removed the periodic condition. The generated specification successfully resolved this conflict by explicitly stating 'Use Dirichlet boundary conditions only: set u=0 on the entire boundary', which aligns perfectly with the ground truth.
